graders.name: review-pr-no-master
graders.criteria: review-pr.md no longer assumes the default branch is master: wherever it referred to master as the base branch it now uses main (or origin/main) or detects the default branch. A note mentioning the old name (e.g. 'renamed from master') passes.

graders.name: changelog-no-master
graders.criteria: changelog.md no longer assumes the default branch is master: wherever it referred to master as the base branch it now uses main (or origin/main) or detects the default branch. A note mentioning the old name (e.g. 'renamed from master') passes.

graders.name: sync-branch-no-master
graders.criteria: sync-branch.md no longer assumes the default branch is master: wherever it referred to master as the base branch it now uses main (or origin/main) or detects the default branch. A note mentioning the old name (e.g. 'renamed from master') passes.

graders.name: branch-refs-correct
graders.criteria: review-pr.md diffs against main (`main...HEAD` or `origin/main...HEAD`, or the detected default branch), changelog.md lists commits since main (`main..HEAD` or equivalent), and sync-branch.md rebases onto `origin/main` (or the detected default branch). The commands are otherwise unchanged in meaning, and new-migration.md is untouched.

graders.name: reports-what-changed
graders.criteria: The final message says which command files were changed and that the others (new-migration) needed no change.
